verdict.rationale: Kimi's own docs state that the Kimi assistant can upload files and answer questions about them, with single- and multi-file Q&A covering pdf, doc and txt files and extracting their text content. Spreadsheets are not explicitly named (only "and more"), and nothing independent confirms how accurate the analysis is. Missing for 10: explicit spreadsheet support, hands-on or independent evidence of analysis accuracy, and depth on analysis features beyond Q&A.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can upload documents, spreadsheets, and PDFs and get accurate analysis of their contents

citations.quote: The Kimi intelligent assistant can upload files and answer questions based on those files.
Best for large codebase analysis, multi-file refactoring, and long-document processing.
